title: Absolute minima and maxima
goal: Find the absolute highest and lowest heights of $f(x, y)$ on a closed region (like a rectangle or disk) by checking both interior flat spots and the outer boundary edges.

beforeThis.skill: Just like endpoints on a 1D interval $[a, b]$, the highest or lowest point on a 2D region very often sits along the outer boundary wall or at a corner!

links.label: Precalculus: Geometry of circles, disks, and rectangles

seeIt.title: Geometric Meaning of the Gradient Vector & Multivariable Optimization
seeIt.creator: Dr. Trefor Bazett
seeIt.watchFor: Explains why optimizing $f(x, y)$ on a closed region requires checking both interior critical points where $\nabla f = \mathbf{0}$ and the boundary.

questions.asking: Find and classify all critical points of $h(x, y) = y(4 - x^2 - y^2)$ in $\mathbb{R}^2$, then compare interior critical points with the boundary circle $x^2 + y^2 = 1$ to find the absolute maximum and minimum on the disk $x^2 + y^2 \le 1$.
questions.statement:
Let $h(x, y) = y(4 - x^2 - y^2)$.

  1. Find and classify the critical points of $h(x, y)$ as local maxima, local minima or saddle points.
  2. Find the maximum and minimum values of $h(x, y)$ on the disk $x^2 + y^2 \le 1$.

questions.asking: Find the absolute maximum and minimum values of $f(x, y) = 5 + 2x - x^2 - 4y^2$ by comparing any interior critical points in $R$ with the values along all four boundary edges and four corners of the rectangle.
questions.statement:
Find the absolute maximum and minimum values of the function $f(x, y) = 5 + 2x - x^2 - 4y^2$ on the rectangular region

$$R = \{(x, y) \mid -1 \le x \le 3, \; -1 \le y \le 1\}.$$

questions.asking: Find the length, width, and height (in terms of $V$) of an open-top rectangular box of volume $V$ that minimizes total surface area $xy + 2xz + 2yz$.
questions.statement: Find the most economical shape of a rectangular box that has a fixed volume $V$ and that has no top.
